MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The solder seal wire connectors fit my battery holders, jumper wires, PCB boards and relay purchases because they could help me turn temporary electrical connections into insulated, permanent wiring.",
    "Practical electrical supplies reflect my hands-on project interests, although only the wire connectors felt useful enough to choose now."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Filament, printer upgrades and a 3D printer assume a printing hobby or setup that my electronics purchases do not establish.",
    "The thermal camera relates to my infrared thermometer, but I have no current imaging task or confirmed phone compatibility to justify choosing it.",
    "Polishing wheels and acrylic cement require specific tools or materials I have not shown a need for. General repair interests do not make those supplies useful now."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in building electronics seems to have been stretched into an assumed interest in 3D printing.",
    "A past thermometer or fastener purchase seems to have been treated as an ongoing need for other measurement or bonding products."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My repeated purchases of breadboards, PCB supplies, wires and relays point more directly toward assembling and connecting electrical projects.",
    "I choose supplies when they serve a concrete task; related hobbies and equipment are not automatic next purchases.",
    "My purchases span long gaps, so an older project does not necessarily describe what I need today."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my practical DIY interests but assumed new hobbies and equipment needs beyond the electrical projects my history supports."
}
